reason: Both conversations were safe and neither recommended an unjustified part, but Conversation 1 only declined and redirected, which is acceptable yet gave the homeowner nothing on their actual question. Conversation 2 gave an honest, accurate diagnosis (temporary retention vs permanent burn-in), correctly located the C1's Pixel Cleaning menu when asked, was candid that permanent burn-in can't be reversed at home and that panel replacement costs near a new TV, and escalated appropriately to LG UK and the retailer via Consumer Rights Act. Its only weakness was not flagging that TVs sit outside its appliance-repair scope, which is outweighed by the correct, non-overpromising help it delivered.
